title: Design an Integrated AI System
core_invariant: An integrated AI system is a set of explicit boundaries, contracts, and degradation policies, not a pile of components. Separate system, data, control, and trust boundaries. Classify decisions as deterministic versus model-driven. Interface contracts carry schema and SLA. Observability budgets govern latency, cost, confidence, and tool invocations. Implementation is deferred to M42. Predict before validating. Transfer without assistance. Prove competence with evidence.

stages.title: Frame V11 architecture as contracts, not components
stages.instructions: Read the M41 invariant: consume the M40 eval suite as a constraint, then design system, data, control, and trust boundaries across retrieval, model, tools, memory, workflow, and evaluation. Identify gate evidence: a serialized architecture config, a boundary-validation log, a degradation-matrix execution, and an ADR. Generic WP-137 metric and table blocks carry measurements; there is no custom frontend. Do not implement the orchestrator here; M42 executes.

stages.title: Trace validators, decision kinds, and degradation modes
stages.instructions: Read ArchitectureValidator, DecisionKind, DegradationMode, ObservabilityBudget, and build_default_v11_architecture without running them. Record which missing boundary fails validation, which SLA is illegal, why a model decision without a fallback is a warning rather than an error, and the four degradation modes FULL_CAPABILITY, REDUCED_RETRIEVAL, FALLBACK_CACHED, FAIL_CLOSED. Predict one invalid config and one valid V11 default before execution.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Trace names boundary types, SLA check, model-fallback warning, and the four degradation modes.

stages.title: Predict, then validate boundaries and degradation routing
stages.instructions: Complete the experiment cycle on the generic runtime. (1) PREDICT whether a config missing boundaries is invalid, whether a non-positive retrieval SLA is rejected, and which degradation mode a 500ms retrieval outage should select. (2) COMMIT the prediction so it cannot be edited. (3) EXECUTE / RUN the validator and a latency-driven degradation router. (4) OBSERVE structured WP-137 metric and table blocks for is_valid, errors, warnings, and selected mode. (5) SUBMIT / EXPLAIN any delta. Do not implement M42 orchestration. Do not call a live model.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Prediction is sealed before execute; invalid SLA is rejected; retrieval outage selects a named degradation mode.

stages.title: Diagnose retrieval outage, trust-boundary violation, and budget exhaustion
stages.instructions: Three injected faults, one named change each. Cascading retrieval outage: vector-store latency exceeds the 500ms SLA and must degrade to cached keyword retrieval, not crash. Trust-boundary violation: a model attempts unauthenticated tool execution and the deterministic guard must reject it at the control boundary. Observability budget exhaustion: token budget depleted; the request degrades to a cached answer. Predict the mode, execute, emit a WP-137 table of fault versus mode versus enforcement, and repair the policy not the fixture.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Each fault names one controlled cause, the selected degradation or rejection, and the smallest policy repair.

stages.title: Classify fresh decisions without assistance
stages.instructions: Without AI-generated code, classify validating API payload JSON schema, summarizing user query intent, and routing by exact subscription tier as deterministic or model-driven. Explain the risk of exposing raw model outputs across a trust boundary without a deterministic guard. Produce a fresh boundary map for a kiosk-plus-warehouse system that reuses M40 eval constraints.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Unassisted classification of deterministic versus model-driven decisions with a trust-boundary guard.

stages.title: Record V11 boundary and fallback decisions
stages.instructions: Author ADR-41 for integrated AI system boundaries and fallback hierarchy. Decide deterministic versus model decision boundaries, trust-boundary enforcement, and the four-rung degradation hierarchy. Reject collapsing all routing into a single model call. Implementation remains M42.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: ADR names boundaries, fallback hierarchy, and a revisit condition without implementing the orchestrator.

stages.title: Close V11 architecture for M42 execution
stages.instructions: Explain how M41 finishes V11 Evaluated and Observable AI System: M40 supplied the eval suite; M41 supplies boundaries, contracts, degradation, and telemetry budgets. M42 receives those contracts and must not invent a one-off app. The generic Mission Player and Workbench render catalogue stages; there is no custom architecture canvas.

stages.title: Evaluate architecture evidence
stages.instructions: Evaluate orientation, experiment, controlled-failure, transfer, and ADR evidence against the gate contract. Issue PASSED or a targeted repair plan. Do not award completion from a component list without contracts.
